title: Mark G Probable NDE 22617
content: I came down with the flu, which turned into pneumonia. We were visiting my wife's brother's house at the time. I went to the hospital the previous day where they took an X-ray that showed pneumonia. I forget the name of the antibiotic, but I started taking it. The next day, my coughing was very bad. I was coughing up blood and feeling like I couldn't breathe right. I was leaning over the sink coughing up this blood and I remember praying for help when, the next thing I knew, I saw what could only be described as a shadowy hand in my mind. I had to make a choice. I was told that I could continue and that we have three times in life to make the choice, but that for me, my health would be worse in the future. I was desperate and I had two small boys at the time. I remember taking the hand and grabbing it and putting it right on my back where the pneumonia had shown on the X-ray. Immediately I stopped coughing. The next day, we were coming home to Virginia and I was having what looked like an allergic reaction to the antibiotic. We stopped at the hospital and the doctor looked at me and said it did look like a reaction. He asked why I was prescribed it and I told him pneumonia. He asked if I had the X-rays and I told I'm that it was done in a hospital in Maryland. He ordered another which showed absolutely no sign of pneumonia.

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw what he described as a 'shadowy hand' in his mind.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Flu that turned into pneumonia; coughing up blood and feeling unable to breathe.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: A 'shadowy hand' appeared in his mind; he was told he had to make a choice and that 'we have three times in life to make the choice.' He grabbed the hand and placed it on his back where pneumonia had been seen on X-ray, and he immediately stopped coughing.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/arrival described; experience centers on an internal vision of a hand, communicated information, and a choice leading to immediate physical improvement.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Internal vision of a 'shadowy hand' offering a choice; claim that people have 'three times in life to make the choice'; immediate cessation of coughing after taking the hand and placing it on his back; subsequent X-ray reportedly showed no pneumonia.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I saw what could only be described as a shadowy hand in my mind.” “I had to make a choice.” “I was told that I could continue and that we have three times in life to make the choice, but that for me, my health would be worse in the future.” “Immediately I stopped coughing.” “(X-ray) showed absolutely no sign of pneumonia.”
